name: OrchestratorAgent
description: The workflow driver — constructed directly in main.py, not registered in AgentRegistry. Makes one LLM pre-flight call (a 'ping' health check) before any step, then loads the project manifest, runs each workflow step with fallback-tier dispatch (workflows/agent_registry.yaml), merges outputs into persistent project state, and builds the final report.

inputs.name: request
inputs.description: The request payload (project_name, workflow, module_filter, etc.)
